title: Bounded diagnosis of a failed uppercase transform

expected_behavior.description: Every alphabetic character is uppercase and the newline is preserved.

failing_validation.name: expected_output_match
failing_validation.detail: observed output is not byte-for-byte equal to expected output

plausible_causes: The transform was applied only to some characters or only once.
The observed file is stale or came from a different input revision.
An encoding or locale path changed the transformation behavior.
instruction: Use only these facts. Return the most supported diagnosis, one minimal observation or repair proposal, and state what remains uncertain. Do not change files.
